title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Sênior
description:
Executar o monitoramento de terceiro nível de atendimento a incidentes de infraestrutura, demandas e rotinas, assegurando um atendimento rápido e com qualidade dentro da estrutura de Cloud Infra da TOTVS.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Atuar na análise e troubleshoot do ambiente na camada N3;
  • Contato com fornecedores para tratativas de RCA (Root Cause Analysis), revisões de contratos, aquisição de serviços e softwares;
  • Condução das tratativas de incidentes e problemas críticos do ambiente de infraestrutura;
  • Planejamento, condução e execução das mudanças em larga escala no ambiente de infraestrutura;
  • Criar e manter automações para as demandas do dia a dia da equipe N1 e N2;
  • Avaliar e propor melhorias no monitoramento de serviços, infraestrutura e aplicações de clientes;
  • Participar ativamente da pesquisa de novas tecnologias, buscando à atualização de conhecimentos e a adoção das melhorias na infraestrutura dos serviços desenvolvidos;
  • Criar documentações e desenhos de arquitetura de todos os ambientes e entregas para os times;
  • Criação de workshops e treinamentos internos para equipes de sustentação N1 e N2;
  • Apoiar a equipe de Projetos e Arquitetura nas definições de novas tecnologias e melhorias para os ambientes da companhia;
  • Revisar e conduzir eventuais melhorias dos fluxos de entrega junto ao time de Governança;
  • Atuar na manutenção e padronização das entregas (catálogo de serviço) de infraestrutura.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Experiência na administração de ambientes VMWare (vCenter, NSX, vROPS, vSAN, VRLI);
  • Experiência como Analista de Sistemas Operacionais;
  • Monitoramento de ambientes com Zabbix, Telegraf e/ou Grafana;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em automação com ShellScript ou Python, Ansible, Salt, Jenkins e VREALIZE AUTOMATION!!!;
  • Inglês - Avançado (conversação e escrita);

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.


  • Você será referência Técnica: Atuando como especialista técnico, orientando o time de engenharia em boas práticas, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas de tecnologia.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar próximo a times de produto, tecnologia e negócio para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções eficazes.
  • Evolução Tecnológica: Apoiar a modernização de sistemas e migração para ambientes em nuvem, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Projetar e apoiar integrações de novos sistemas com a infraestrutura existente, assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo no time.
  • Conciliação de Informações: Apoiar a construção de soluções para conciliações de pequenos, médios e grandes comércios, além de fluxos regulatórios (bandeiras, BACEN, etc.).


✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência em Arquitetura de Software: Sólido conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e data engineering.
  • Gestão de Riscos Técnicos: Capacidade de identificar riscos em soluções e propor alternativas.
  • Vivência técnica com: ORACLE, PL SQL, SQL, JAVA, DATABRICKS, SPARK/SCALA;
  • Kubernetes e Cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud);
  • APIs e Integrações: atuação em Integração de Sistemas: Capacidade de projetar e validar soluções interoperáveis em ambientes complexos.


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Experiência em empresas de adquirência ou tecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com fluxo de extrato financeiro.
  • Atuação anterior como Tech Lead ou Especialista Técnico em projetos de modernização de plataformas de dados.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 54857


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Consultor(a) SAP Basis - Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos procurando um(a) Consultor(a) SAP Basis Pleno/Sênior para atuar na administração de ambientes SAP complexos, tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável pela sustentação técnica, melhorias contínuas e participação ativa em projetos de atualização, migração e arquitetura SAP, com foco em Managed Services.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Administração de ambientes SAP ECC, S/4HANA e componentes relacionados;
  • Instalação, upgrade e aplicação de pacotes técnicos (Support Package, Kernel, EHP);
  • Troubleshooting, análise de performance e resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Apoio técnico à equipe e documentação de boas práticas;
  • Suporte a projetos em cloud (AWS/Azure) e migração para HANA.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis e administração de ambientes SAP;
  • Conhecimento em NetWeaver, S/4HANA e Solution Manager 7.2;
  • Conhecimento em administração de usuários, governança, GRC-AC/PC;
  • Sistemas operacionais (Linux/Windows) e bancos HANA ou Oracle;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, análise de dumps, logs e performance.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e suporte SAP.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificação SAP Basis (ex: C_TADM_21), Cloud (AWS/Azure) ou HANA;
  • Experiência com ambientes SAP em cloud pública (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • Experiência com automação (scripts, Ansible) e monitoração (Zabbix, Focused Run);
  • Vivência em projetos de migração (SWPM, DMO, SUM) e upgrades.


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Gerente de vendas - Terraplanagem
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas para terraplanagem, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);
  • Experiência comprovada na função de gerência comercial em empresas do segmento de máquinas pesadas (Terraplanagem);
  • Histórico de liderança de equipes comerciais e gestão de territórios nacionais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro, canais de distribuição e estratégias de penetração comercial.

Estamos em busca de Sourcer Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação North America e LATAM da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.   • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer
description:
Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer


Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join one of our key partners in building the next generation of digital commerce infrastructure. This role is focused on creating high-performance, scalable backend services that power mission-critical features for large-scale retailers and digital platforms. You will be part of a team that is shaping backend architecture, ensuring reliability under high transaction volume, and driving continuous innovation in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python.

- Develop scalable and reliable systems capable of supporting high-traffic environments.

- Implement data validation and service architecture using frameworks such as FastAPI and Pydantic.

- Optimize and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, ensuring performance and data integrity.

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services in Google Cloud Platform, using best practices for cloud-native development.

- Integrate backend services with Firebase for authentication, messaging, or real-time features.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and contribute to architectural decisions.

- Troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement long-term solutions for system reliability.


Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering with Node.js and Python.

- Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning).

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services in production environments.

- Hands-on experience with FastAPI and Pydantic , or equivalent Python frameworks.

- Experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform.

- Familiarity with Firebase services (authentication, cloud messaging, or data synchronization).


Nice to have

- Experience working with microservices or event-driven architectures.

- Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with observability tools and monitoring best practices.

title: Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer
description:
Senior Backend (Node+Python) Engineer


Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join one of our key partners in building the next generation of digital commerce infrastructure. This role is focused on creating high-performance, scalable backend services that power mission-critical features for large-scale retailers and digital platforms. You will be part of a team that is shaping backend architecture, ensuring reliability under high transaction volume, and driving continuous innovation in a cloud-native environment.


Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python.

- Develop scalable and reliable systems capable of supporting high-traffic environments.

- Implement data validation and service architecture using frameworks such as FastAPI and Pydantic.

- Optimize and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, ensuring performance and data integrity.

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services in Google Cloud Platform, using best practices for cloud-native development.

- Integrate backend services with Firebase for authentication, messaging, or real-time features.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and contribute to architectural decisions.

- Troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement long-term solutions for system reliability.


Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering with Node.js and Python.

- Strong expertise with PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning).

- Experience building RESTful APIs and backend services in production environments.

- Hands-on experience with FastAPI and Pydantic , or equivalent Python frameworks.

- Experience deploying and managing applications on Google Cloud Platform.

- Familiarity with Firebase services (authentication, cloud messaging, or data synchronization).


Nice to have

- Experience working with microservices or event-driven architectures.

- Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ).

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with observability tools and monitoring best practices.

title: Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)
description:
Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)

We are looking for a talented software developer with strong mobile app development experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modern tech stacks, integrating AI into their workflow, and solving complex system-level problems that drive our product forward.

Must-Have Skills
  • Mobile app development experience (iOS preferred, Swift expertise required).
  • Familiarity with CICD pipelines and Git workflows.
  • Strong coding skills in at least two of the following:
  • Python

  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


We are seeking a highly motivated Sr. Product Analyst to join our team. This individual will be part of our Product team focused on revenue and growth by ensuring we are attracting and binding the right customers for the right products.


Main responsibilities

  • Obtain, evaluate, and communicate information that supports revenue growth and profitability.
  • Query and analyze information across different databases using data correlation and statistical analysis.
  • Identify market segments based on conversion, performance and customer segmentation metrics.
  • Recommends strategies for improving results and market position.
  • Prepare exhibits/presentations, and clearly communicate results to stakeholders.



Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years of related experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Math, Statistics, Actuarial, Finance, Economics
  • Auto Insurance background (highly preferred)
  • Fluency in English



Software / Tools

  • Microsoft Office suite – Excel and Power Point (proficient)
  • Snowflake (intermediate)
  • SQL (intermediate)
  • Power Bi (intermediate)



Other Critical Skills

  • Data Query and Analysis
  • Data presentation
  • Collaborative
  • Strong Communication skills
  • Inquisitive



Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally reknowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development


About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023.

title: Senior Rust Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Rust Software Engineer to deliver high-quality, high-performance systems. You'll be writing Rust-first code to tackle complex systems challenges, acting as a technical leader on client projects, and independently designing robust, scalable, and memory-safe solutions. You will champion best practices and elevate the engineering bar for mission-critical applications:


Must-have skills:

- Expert-level proficiency in the Rust programming language, including a deep understanding of core concepts like the Ownership Model, Borrow Checker, Lifetimes, Traits, and Macros.

- Strong background in systems programming concepts, including multithreading, concurrent programming, and performance-critical application development.

- Extensive experience with asynchronous programming in Rust, particularly using frameworks like Tokio and understanding the nuances of async/await.

- Proven experience designing and implementing highly scalable backend services and distributed systems.

- Proficiency with the Rust toolchain, including Cargo , and strong experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling and resolving complex architectural and coding challenges.


Nice-to-haves:

- Ideal experience working with video processing related projects with real time systems and web containers.

- Ideal experience utilizing webRTC , real time system response, publishing on multiple platforms.


The icing on the Kake:

  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

Health insurance

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: ZEISS MED | Banco de Talentos para Técnicos e Engenheiros de Campo | Salvador!
description:
Estamos sempre analisando os currículos cadastrados e, havendo uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato para que você participe de nosso processo seletivo!



Sobre a ZEISS:

- Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.



Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

- Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.


Sobre o nosso Banco de Talentos para Técnicos e Engenheiro de Campo:

Base de Trabalho - Salvador e região.


Atividades:

- Instalação, treinamento aos usuários e manutenção (preventiva e corretiva) de equipamentos médicos.

- Manter registros dos serviços executados e enviar relatórios dos atendimentos realizados.

- Garantir a satisfação do cliente de acordo com métricas de atendimento, prazo, performance e qualidade.


Requisitos:

- Experiência anterior com instalação e manutenção de equipamentos médicos.

- Conhecimentos em TI (Hardware / Software / Redes - instalação / formatação / configuração).

- Graduação em Engenharia e/ou formação técnica (Eletrotécnica, Eletromecânica, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Elétrica).

- CNH em dia e disponibilidade para viagens.

- Bom nível de Inglês é imprescindível.


Nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão:

A ZEISS promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Independente de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, idade, crença ou deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas são bem-vindas em nossos processos seletivos. Valorizamos a diversidade, respeitamos as diferenças e trabalhamos continuamente para construir um ambiente mais justo, inclusivo e com equidade.

Superior Completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

Noções das técnicas para elaboração e análise do planejamento financeiro e orçamentário, conceitos de custo standard e custo médio, noções em sistema de custeio (ex.: absorção, real, padrão);

Noções de princípios de contabilidade (ex.: análise de demonstrativo financeiro, reconhecimento de despesas/receita), impostos indiretos (ex. ICMS, PIS, COFINS), do processo comercial e logístico;

Desejável experiência na área da controladoria em indústria;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office;

Conhecimento em Sistema Integrado (ERP).


Atividades:

Elaborar orçamento anual das áreas de administração de vendas, trading, merchandising e marketing.

Realizar mensalmente o processo de análise e entendimento das variações do planejamento orçamentário (Real x Planejado), interagindo com os clientes internos para entendimento e análise das variações, bem como sugerindo ações corretivas e/ou preventivas para os desvios observados.

Acompanhar, analisar e manter controle dos custos de marketing, merchandising, trading e administração de vendas.

Realizar reuniões junto as áreas para demonstração de dados e análises orçamentárias.

Elaborar e analisar relatórios de gastos por centro de custo.

Prestar suporte na elaboração do Forecast.

Realizar as atividades da sua função conforme as normas técnicas, procedimentos da qualidade, limpeza, organização, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.

Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer


Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm?


Look no further! WebCreek is hiring a DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.


This role focuses on ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure through automation, continuous integration, and deployment best practices. You’ll take the lead on optimizing cloud environments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and implementing monitoring and security strategies to support high-performance software delivery. In this fast-paced environment, your expertise will be key to driving efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement across all development and operations processes.


What You'll Do

  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
  • Deploy and manage infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Terraform (IaC).
  • Automate processes with PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools.
  • Ensure smooth integration between on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to enhance delivery pipelines.
  • Apply security and compliance best practices across systems and workflows.


What You Have

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.
  • Strong background in CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, including integration with on-premises infrastructure (hybrid environments).

title: Supervisor de Lazer
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar os agentes de viagens;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Garantir um atendimento de excelência aos clientes, presencialmente, por telefone ou online;
  • Resolver conflitos, reclamações e situações complexas de atendimento;
  • Manter um padrão de qualidade nos serviços prestados pela equipe.
  • Supervisionar a montagem de pacotes turísticos, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Apoiar na negociação com fornecedores (companhias aéreas, hotéis, operadoras, etc.);
  • Garantir que as ofertas estejam atualizadas, competitivas e dentro das políticas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar reservas, emissões, alterações e cancelamentos de serviços;
  • Monitorar prazos, documentos e pagamentos junto aos fornecedores;
  • Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas legais e políticas internas.
  • Colaborar com o setor comercial para alcançar metas de vendas;
  • Sugerir campanhas, promoções e ações para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Analisar relatórios de desempenho e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar metas, produtividade e qualidade do atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados à direção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre destinos, tendências do mercado e novidades do setor;
  • Incentivar a equipe a participar de treinamentos, workshops e famtours.
  • Mais as atribuições de vendas, pois o supervisor também vende


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento dos destinos de viagem, geografia.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Ensino médio completo, desejável ensino superior em turismo.
  • Experiência em agência de viagens multimarcas.

title: SR Desenvolvimento Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior com sólida experiência em Java , Node.js e Arquiteturas avançadas para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. A pessoa ideal será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, assim como atuar próximo ao Tech Lead para definições técnicas para o desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar Tech Lead em Definições Técnica: Orientar decisões arquiteturais, definir stack tecnológico e estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Auxiliar Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar em dúvidas tecnicas equipes, conduzir code reviews e desenvolver programadores pleno/júnior;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar aplicações para alta performance, implementar estratégias de cache e load balancing;
  • Segurança Corporativa: Implementar práticas de segurança, auditoria de código e compliance com padrões enterprise;
  • Integração Complexa: Desenvolver integrações críticas com sistemas legados, APIs de terceiros e serviços externos;
  • Disaster Recovery: Projetar estratégias de backup, recuperação e alta disponibilidade;
  • Inovação Técnica: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, POCs e melhorias de processo;
  • Gestão de Incidentes: Auxiliar troubleshooting de problemas críticos em produção;

title: Analista de Atração e Seleção
description:
Quem somos?


A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.


Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.


Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.


Sobre a vaga


Atribuições:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta — desde a triagem de currículos até entrevistas, aplicação de testes e apoio à tomada de decisão;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos para posições em nossas unidades internacionais, adaptando estratégias de atração conforme o perfil local e alinhando-se à cultura;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) dos gestores, mantendo-os informados e engajados durante todo o processo;
  • Ministrar integrações para novos colaboradores, garantindo uma jornada de entrada acolhedora e alinhada à nossa cultura;
  • Realizar processos de admissão e acompanhar a avaliação de experiência dos novos talentos;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as nossas unidades em todo o Brasil nos temas relacionados à seleção;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica nas ações de marca empregadora (employer branding), fortalecendo o posicionamento da empresa em universidades, fóruns, feiras de carreira, cursos técnicos e demais canais de relacionamento com candidatos;
  • Contribuir com iniciativas que fortaleçam nossa cultura e promovam um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo;
  • Utilizar sistemas de recrutamento e seleção (ATS) para garantir organização e rastreabilidade dos processos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores da área (tempo de contratação, SLA de vagas, fontes de atração, entre outros), propondo melhorias contínuas nos processos e a melhor experiência para candidatos e gestores;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de Atração e Seleção gerando insights para melhoria contínua dos processos e apoio à tomada de decisão.


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Psicologia;
  • Conhecimentos em condução de processos seletivos e entrevistas por competências;
  • Possuir CNH Cat. B e ter disponibilidade para viagens.


*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: Network Security Specialist, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher

  • Gympass

  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
DESENVOLVEDOR JAVA BACKEND PLENO


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação; OU
  • Conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior acompanhado de certificado de curso de pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação.


Obrigatório

  • Experiência exercendo atividades como desenvolvedores de aplicações Java EE 6+ com Springboot.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um dos servidores:

* Apache Tomcat;

* JBoss/Wildfly;

* Open Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior.


  • Noções ou familiaridade com APIS REST
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e POO
  • Conhecimento de padrão de projeto, qualidade de código, boas práticas
  • Conhecimentos em SOLID
  • Conhecimentos em JPA


Desejável

  • Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.
  • Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.
  • Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas IBM DB2, MS SQL Server, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

Informações adicionais:

Atuação remota

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- GOOGLE CORE WEB VITALS

- LCP

- CLS

- TTFB

- GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

- DESIGN DE EXPERIENCIA DO USUARIO (UX/UI)

- HTML semântico

- JAVASCRIPT MODERNO (ES6+)

- DESENVOLVEDOR REACT

- DESENVOLVIMENTO COM NEXT.JS

- Nuxt.js

- PWA (PROGRESSIVE WEB APPS)

- ADMINISTRACAO DA CLOUD AWS

- PROCESSAMENTO DE SITEMAPS

- DATADOG RUM (REAL USER MONITORING)


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Foco em resultados

- Resolução de problemas complexos

- COMUNICATIVO

- Adaptação e Aprendizado Contínuo

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid/Senior)
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. While we’re primarily seeking professionals comfortable working across the stack, from building Vue.js + TypeScript interfaces to developing Kotlin/Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, we also welcome candidates with strong Frontend or Backend experience who are eager to collaborate in a full-stack environment.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement full-stack features and applications.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs using Kotlin/Spring Boot.
  • Build intuitive, responsive UIs with Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with PostgreSQL to design efficient schemas and queries.
  • Ensure high-quality code through testing (Playwright) and code reviews.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you :

Mid-Level Engineers

  • Experience with Kotlin/Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Proficiency with Vue.js and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and databases.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Good English communication skills.


Senior Engineers

  • Deep expertise across backend and frontend, able to design end-to-end systems.
  • Strong architectural knowledge focused on scalability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring peers and leading technical discussions.
  • Ability to balance priorities across the stack.
  • Good English communication skills.


Differential requirements:

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Brazil | SRE, Java & .NET Engineers (Remote)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Our mission is to be a meaningful part of our people's careers. As we grow, so does our determination to offer the best experience to our employees and clients — and that’s exactly what drives us. We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Óbidos, and representations in Brazil and Tunisia. We have over 12 years of market expertise, and today we are a universe of around 400 people working on-site, remotely or in hybrid mode in projects across 20+ countries.


We believe that great people make successful companies, and that’s why we stand for the appreciation, recognition and growth of our professionals.


We don’t want to be just another line on your CV — we want you to live a Lifetime Experience with us. We invest in training and certifications that confirm your real progression, in promoting a healthy work-life balance, and in offering benefits that impact your personal life and career.


#welcometoyourfuture



What we’re looking for:


Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

– 4 to 6 years of experience

– Strong knowledge in DevOps and Operations

– Experience with monitoring, CI/CD, cloud , and system reliability practices


⚙️ Java Engineer

– 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development

– Interest in learning new technologies , such as Python

– Experience with integration, APIs, testing, and troubleshooting
